name: Morrigan
subtitle: Emissary of Destiny
description: Bring Dark Tidings to the battle, casting Despair and Debuffs on your foes.
lore: Goddess of war and fate, the Morrigan is a source of both fear and courage throughout Avalon. It was to her that Destiny turned upon restitching the world, and the Morrigan now acts primarily as an agent and emissary for that mysterious power. She guides and oversees the Scions—though she still does, on occasion, pursue objectives of her own.
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when dealing damage to enemies under [Dark Tidings].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Omen of the Raven
Ignore RES +20%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, Strong Hit Chance Multiplier +15%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Fate Foretold
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (200%ATK+5%INIT) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:init-down-ii] on the target for 1 turn. Then place [mechanic:dark-tidings] on the target.

skills.name: Dark Tidings
skills.description: Place 2 stacks of [mechanic:dark-tidings] on all enemies, then attack all enemies (200%ATK+5%INIT) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:despair] on each target for 1 turn. If the target is a Boss, place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Omen of the Raven
skills.description: Remove all [Buffs] from all enemies, then attack all enemies (100%ATK+2%INIT)3 times. The first hit has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:drain-ii] on each target for 2 turns. The second hit has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:def-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns. The third hit has a 80% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If all 3[Debuffs] are placed on the target, also decrease the target’s Turn Meter by 30%.

skills.name: Futuresight
skills.description: When an enemy receives a [Buff], reduce its duration by 1 turn. When an enemy receives a [Debuff], increase its duration by 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: Decrease the target’s RES and ACC by 5 (up to 100) each time they receive a stack of [Dark Tidings].

imprint_passive: When an enemy receives a [Buff], has a 50% chance to reduce its duration by 1 turn. When an enemy receives a [Debuff], has a 50% chance to increase its duration by 1 turn.
